AS-0630.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-0630.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-0631.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-0631.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-0631.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-0633.A: السبب إنه غلط: Blind endometrial sampling can miss a focal polyp and does not remove it; sampling is the step for AUB over 45 or thickened endometrium without a focal lesion.
AS-0633.B: السبب إنه غلط: Repeat scanning (observation) is only for polyps that are asymptomatic AND under 1 cm; this one is symptomatic and 13 mm.
AS-0633.C: السبب إنه غلط: Progestogens do not remove a structural lesion; they are used for anovulatory bleeding or hyperplasia without atypia, not for a polyp.

AS-0633B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy is far too radical for a benign polyp in a young woman; it is kept for failed conservative treatment, completed family with other pathology, or malignancy.
AS-0633B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Blood transfusion treats the consequence, not the cause. It becomes the first step when the anemia is symptomatic (fatigue, dizziness, tachycardia, hypotension) or bleeding is ongoing and heavy, which the stem does not describe; the source also highlighted this option.

AS-0661.A: السبب إنه غلط: Superficial inguinal nodes drain the vulva, lower vagina and the uterine cornu along the round ligament; they are not the main drainage of the fundus.
AS-0661.B: السبب إنه غلط: Deep inguinal nodes receive lymph from the superficial inguinal nodes and the lower limb; they are not a staging group for uterine cancer.
AS-0661.C: السبب إنه غلط: Internal iliac nodes drain the cervix and lower uterine body; they would be the answer for a cervical or lower uterine tumor, not a fundal one.

AS-0664.B: السبب إنه غلط: Hypopituitarism lowers pituitary output (TSH, FSH, LH, prolactin); here TSH and prolactin are high.
AS-0664.C: السبب إنه غلط: Hyperprolactinemia is present but is secondary; a primary prolactinoma would not raise TSH, so always check TSH before blaming the pituitary.
AS-0664.D: السبب إنه غلط: PCOS needs hyperandrogenism or polycystic ovaries and often a raised LH:FSH ratio; none is given and it does not raise TSH.

AS-0671.A: السبب إنه غلط: A routine urine culture does not grow gonococci; first void urine NAAT is acceptable but less sensitive than a genital swab in women.
AS-0671.B: السبب إنه غلط: Rectal or anogenital swabs are added when there is anal exposure or anorectal symptoms; they are not the primary site in this presentation.
AS-0671.D: السبب إنه غلط: The vagina is lined by squamous epithelium that gonococci do not infect; a high vaginal swab is for candida, bacterial vaginosis and trichomonas.

AS-0679.A: السبب إنه غلط: Induction of labor means vaginal delivery, which is contraindicated when the placenta covers the internal os.
AS-0679.B: السبب إنه غلط: Immediate cesarean is right for severe active bleeding, maternal instability or fetal distress before 37 weeks; here bleeding has stopped and she is stable.
AS-0679.D: السبب إنه غلط: Awaiting labor is unsafe and vaginal birth is impossible with a complete previa; delivery must be a planned cesarean before labor.

AS-0683.A: السبب إنه غلط: 600 IU is the general recommended daily allowance for adults and pregnant women without risk factors; it is not enough for this high-risk woman.
AS-0683.C: السبب إنه غلط: 2000 IU is a higher dose used in some regimens for those with documented low levels; it is not the standard prophylactic dose for risk factors alone.
AS-0683.D: السبب إنه غلط: 4000 IU is the usual tolerable upper intake for adults, a ceiling, not a routine daily recommendation.

AS-0688.A: السبب إنه غلط: CBC is supportive (anemia, blood loss) but cannot locate the pregnancy or decide the diagnosis.
AS-0688.C: السبب إنه غلط: CT exposes the fetus to radiation and is inferior to ultrasound for early pregnancy; it has no role here.
AS-0688.D: السبب إنه غلط: Further deep vaginal examination adds pain and, with a possible ectopic, risks rupture; imaging, not repeated palpation, is needed to rule out masses.

AS-0691.A: السبب إنه غلط: Informing her father breaches the confidentiality of a competent adult; family can be involved only with her consent.
AS-0691.B: السبب إنه غلط: Informing her mother is the same breach of confidentiality; her age makes her the decision maker.
AS-0691.D: السبب إنه غلط: NRT in pregnancy is considered only when she wants to quit and behavioural support alone has failed; drugs are pointless for someone not ready to stop.

AS-0692.B: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy is never the procedure for a tubal ectopic in a woman seeking fertility; it is reserved for uncontrollable uterine haemorrhage (e.g. cornual or scar rupture) when nothing else works.
AS-0692.C: السبب إنه غلط: Removing both tubes is justified only when the report shows a <bdi>left hydrosalpinx</bdi>, because hydrosalpinx fluid refluxes into the uterus and lowers IVF implantation; the recall's key chose tubal conservation instead.
AS-0692.D: السبب إنه غلط: Methotrexate needs a stable patient, hCG ≤5000, no cardiac activity and a mass <bdi><4 cm</bdi>; a 4 cm ectopic fails the size rule, and an intraoperative injection is not a substitute for removing it.

AS-0696.A: السبب إنه غلط: Ultrasound comes after β-hCG, which tells you what to look for (and transvaginal, not abdominal, is preferred in early pregnancy); it would be first only once pregnancy is already confirmed.
AS-0696.C: السبب إنه غلط: The cause of her 3 year infertility is an elective outpatient work-up; it is irrelevant until an acute ectopic or other emergency is excluded.
AS-0696.D: السبب إنه غلط: Analgesia treats the symptom, not the cause; it is supportive and would never replace establishing pregnancy status first.

AS-0717.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin augmentation is for the active phase when contractions are inadequate and the cervix has not changed for about 6 hours; it is not used to speed up a normal latent phase.
AS-0717.B: السبب إنه غلط: Amniotomy is an augmentation step in established labor; with the head high at -2 and no active labor, it risks cord prolapse and commits her to delivery without an indication.

AS-0724.A: السبب إنه غلط: HbA1c is not used to diagnose GDM; it is used to detect pre-existing diabetes early in pregnancy or to judge control in known diabetics.
AS-0724.B: السبب إنه غلط: A random glucose is neither a screening nor a diagnostic test for GDM in an asymptomatic woman; it would only matter if she had symptoms of overt hyperglycaemia.
AS-0724.D: السبب إنه غلط: The 3-hour 100 g test is the second (diagnostic) step of the two-step approach, done only after an abnormal 1-hour 50 g challenge; it is not the first test offered.

AS-0727.A: السبب إنه غلط: Cervical biopsy is for a visible cervical lesion or an abnormal Pap/colposcopy (postcoital bleeding points to the cervix); it does not sample the endometrium.
AS-0727.C: السبب إنه غلط: A vaginal (speculum) exam is part of the initial assessment to find the bleeding source, but it gives no tissue and cannot confirm a diagnosis.

AS-0728.B: السبب إنه غلط: Mammography is not a screening test at 22 in an average-risk woman; routine screening starts at 40, earlier only with high genetic or family risk.
AS-0728.C: السبب إنه غلط: The option text was not recalled; whatever it was, Pap cytology is the screening test indicated at this age.
AS-0728.D: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic ultrasound is not a screening test in asymptomatic women; it is used to investigate symptoms or an abnormal exam.

AS-0728B.A: السبب إنه غلط: Screening under 21 is not recommended even if sexually active, because cervical changes at this age usually regress and treatment causes harm; she would be screened now only if she were already 21 or older.
AS-0728B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Three years is the repeat interval after a normal Pap between 21 and 29, not the time to the first screen.
AS-0728B.D: السبب إنه غلط: Symptoms (postcoital bleeding, discharge) call for a diagnostic exam at any age; screening does not wait for symptoms.

AS-0748.A: السبب إنه غلط: Increase is the answer most standard sources favour, because cavity entry at myomectomy leaves an endometrial scar like a cesarean; it is not the key on this recall.
AS-0748.B: السبب إنه غلط: Decrease is never correct: uterine scarring can only raise accreta risk or leave it unchanged.
AS-0748.C: السبب إنه غلط: Unknown is wrong because the association between prior uterine surgery and accreta is well established.

AS-0924.B: السبب إنه غلط: 4 mg (5 mg in many settings) is the high-risk dose, for a previous NTD pregnancy, antiepileptic drugs, diabetes, obesity or hemolytic anemia; she is healthy.
AS-0924.C: السبب إنه غلط: 10 mg is not a standard preconception folic acid dose for any risk group.
AS-0924.D: السبب إنه غلط: 15 mg is not a standard preconception folic acid dose and far exceeds any recommended regimen.

AS-0943.A: السبب إنه غلط: Salt restriction and rest are not a specific management for resolved gestational hypertension; general lifestyle advice is reasonable but bed rest has no role.
AS-0943.C: السبب إنه غلط: Annual BP checks are the long-term follow-up after gestational hypertension because of raised lifelong cardiovascular risk, but at 4 weeks postpartum with a borderline 133/88 she needs a nearer recheck to see whether hypertension persists and needs treatment.

AS-0961.B: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy is not acceptable as primary treatment of CIN 3 because it is overtreatment and can miss occult invasion that a cone would have staged. It is right for recurrent or persistent high grade CIN when repeat excision is not feasible, or when another gynecologic indication exists.
AS-0961.C: السبب إنه غلط: HPV vaccine is prophylactic and does not treat an existing lesion; it is also not routinely given at 49. It is right for primary prevention, ideally before sexual debut.
AS-0961.D: السبب إنه غلط: Repeating colposcopy delays treatment of a lesion that is already diagnosed. Surveillance with colposcopy and cytology is right for CIN 1, or for CIN 2 in a young woman who prioritizes future pregnancy, not for CIN 3.

AS-0963.A: السبب إنه غلط: Maternal vital signs are checked in every labor but they do not assess fetal wellbeing, which is the concern with a small fetus. They are the key surveillance when the risk is maternal, such as hemorrhage or preeclampsia.
AS-0963.B: السبب إنه غلط: Intermittent auscultation is the standard for a low risk, uncomplicated labor with a normally grown fetus. A fetus below the 10th percentile is high risk, so intermittent listening is not enough.

AS-0963B.A: السبب إنه غلط: Maternal pulse and blood pressure are recorded in every labor but say nothing about fetal wellbeing. They become the focus when there is a maternal risk such as hemorrhage or preeclampsia.
AS-0963B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Contractions are assessed during labor to judge progress, but contraction monitoring alone does not tell you whether the fetus is coping. It is paired with fetal heart assessment, not a substitute for it.
AS-0963B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Early identification of complications is the goal of intrapartum surveillance, not a surveillance method. It describes why we monitor rather than how.

AS-0965.B: السبب إنه غلط: Hormonal IUD: the LNG IUD is a good first line option to control bleeding and pain in adenomyosis, but it is symptomatic, not definitive. Right if the question asked for initial or fertility sparing management.
AS-0965.C: السبب إنه غلط: Oral contraceptive pills: symptomatic medical therapy only; the adenomyotic tissue remains.
AS-0965.D: السبب إنه غلط: Dilatation and curettage: samples only the endometrium and cannot reach disease within the myometrium; neither diagnostic nor curative for adenomyosis.

AS-0969.B: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin is a uterotonic; it has no role in a viable ongoing pregnancy and is ineffective in the first trimester.
AS-0969.C: السبب إنه غلط: D&C would end a viable pregnancy; it is for incomplete or missed abortion with significant bleeding.
AS-0969.D: السبب إنه غلط: Methergine contracts the uterus and is used for postpartum or post-evacuation bleeding, not for a viable pregnancy.

AS-0975.A: السبب إنه غلط: Misoprostol (medical management) is valid up to 20 weeks and is chosen if expectant management fails or the woman prefers it; when expectant care is offered under 13 weeks, it comes first.
AS-0975.B: السبب إنه غلط: Mifepristone is only a priming adjunct given before misoprostol; it is never the first step alone.
AS-0975.C: السبب إنه غلط: D&C is for heavy bleeding, haemodynamic instability, infection, or failed expectant or medical management; none is present here.

AS-0999.A: السبب إنه غلط: Observation fits gestational transient thyrotoxicosis (hCG driven, often with hyperemesis, no goiter or bruit). A diffuse goiter with bruit is Graves and overt disease must be treated to protect mother and fetus.
AS-0999.C: السبب إنه غلط: Radioactive iodine is contraindicated in pregnancy because it crosses the placenta and ablates the fetal thyroid. It is a definitive option only in non pregnant patients.
AS-0999.D: السبب إنه غلط: Thyroidectomy is reserved for failure or intolerance of antithyroid drugs, ideally in the second trimester. It is not first line.

AS-1001.B: السبب إنه غلط: Complete abortion means all tissue has passed and the cervix has closed with an empty uterus on ultrasound. Here the cervix is open and tissue is retained.
AS-1001.C: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion has an open cervix but no tissue passed yet (products may be felt at the os). This patient already passed tissue at home.
AS-1001.D: السبب إنه غلط: Septic abortion needs signs of infection: fever, foul smelling discharge and uterine tenderness. None are described here.

AS-1002.B: السبب إنه غلط: Progesterone from mid pregnancy is used to reduce recurrence of <bdi>preterm</bdi> birth after a prior spontaneous preterm delivery or a short cervix. It has no role in preventing post term pregnancy.
AS-1002.C: السبب إنه غلط: Low dose aspirin started before 16 weeks prevents preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction in high risk women. It does not affect gestational length at term.
AS-1002.D: السبب إنه غلط: Walking or ambulation late in pregnancy has no proven effect on the onset of labor. It is general advice, not a prevention strategy for post term pregnancy.

AS-1003.A: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy is the last resort when tamponade, embolization or vessel ligation have failed, or in uncontrollable life threatening bleeding. It is not the first step after uterotonics.
AS-1003.C: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine artery embolization is the step after a failed balloon in a hemodynamically stable patient (unstable patients go to uterine artery ligation). It needs interventional radiology and comes after tamponade.

AS-1004.A: السبب إنه غلط: Methotrexate is given only once an ectopic pregnancy is established (or a nonviable PUL confirmed); giving it now could end a viable early intrauterine pregnancy.
AS-1004.C: السبب إنه غلط: A scan after only 48 hours adds little on its own; the hCG trend guides when a repeat ultrasound will be informative.
AS-1004.D: السبب إنه غلط: Discharge without follow up is unsafe because ectopic pregnancy has not been excluded.

AS-1036B.A: السبب إنه غلط: Thyroidectomy in pregnancy is reserved for failure or intolerance of antithyroid drugs or compressive symptoms, ideally in the second trimester. She has no dysphagia or dyspnea and has not tried medical therapy.
AS-1036B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Radioactive iodine is contraindicated in pregnancy because it ablates the fetal thyroid. It is a definitive option only after delivery and outside breastfeeding.
AS-1036B.D: السبب إنه غلط: Propylthiouracil is preferred only in the first trimester. After that, methimazole is used to avoid PTU hepatotoxicity.

AS-1042.B: السبب إنه غلط: Yoga and relaxation techniques may help some women, but the evidence is weaker than for regular aerobic exercise, so it is not the best answer.
AS-1042.C: السبب إنه غلط: Hot baths or heat packs relieve crampy pain in primary dysmenorrhea; they do not prevent the mood and physical symptoms of PMS.
AS-1042.D: السبب إنه غلط: Cutting caffeine is often advised as part of lifestyle change, but its benefit is weakly supported and it is not the best evidenced measure.

AS-1043.A: السبب إنه غلط: Septic abortion needs signs of infection: fever, foul smelling discharge, uterine tenderness. None are described here.
AS-1043.C: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion has an <bdi>open</bdi> cervix (usually with bleeding and cramps) with products not yet passed; here the os is closed and there is no bleeding.
AS-1043.D: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion requires a <bdi>viable</bdi> fetus (heartbeat present) with bleeding and a closed os. Here there is no heartbeat and no bleeding.

AS-1043B.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1043B.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1043B.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1044.A: السبب إنه غلط: Missed abortion is fetal demise (no heartbeat) usually with no bleeding; nothing here indicates a nonviable pregnancy.
AS-1044.B: السبب إنه غلط: Normal pregnancy is not the label once there is vaginal bleeding: by exam convention, any early pregnancy bleeding with a closed os and no proven loss is threatened abortion.
AS-1044.C: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion needs an <bdi>open</bdi> cervical os with heavier bleeding and cramps; here the os is closed.

AS-1044B.A: السبب إنه غلط: Complete abortion requires passage of all tissue with a closed os and empty uterus; here only some tissue has passed.
AS-1044B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion has an open os but no tissue passed yet; here tissue has already passed.
AS-1044B.D: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion has a closed cervix, no tissue passage and a viable pregnancy.

AS-1044C.A: السبب إنه غلط: Missed abortion has a <bdi>closed</bdi> cervix with no tissue passed; the fetus has died but is retained, often with little or no bleeding.
AS-1044C.B: السبب إنه غلط: Ectopic pregnancy does not cause an open os with passage of products of conception; it presents with pain, spotting and a closed os with no intrauterine pregnancy.
AS-1044C.C: السبب إنه غلط: An open cervix with tissue passing means the pregnancy is being lost; it cannot be a healthy ongoing pregnancy.

AS-1044D.A: السبب إنه غلط: Complete abortion has a closed os and an empty uterus on ultrasound; here the os is open and tissue remains.
AS-1044D.B: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion has an open os but no tissue passed yet; this patient already passed tissue.
AS-1044D.D: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion has a closed os and a viable ongoing pregnancy without tissue passage.

AS-1044E.A: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion is an open os with <bdi>no tissue passed yet</bdi> (products may be felt at the cervix). Tissue found in the vagina moves it to incomplete.
AS-1044E.C: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion has a <bdi>closed</bdi> os and a viable pregnancy; here the cervix is open and tissue has passed.
AS-1044E.D: السبب إنه غلط: Complete molar pregnancy usually gives a uterus larger than dates, very high hCG and a snowstorm ultrasound, with grape-like vesicles if passed; here the uterus matches 7 to 8 weeks and the tissue is ordinary products of conception.

AS-1044F.A: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion is an open os with <bdi>no tissue passed</bdi>; she reports passing tissue.
AS-1044F.C: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion fits her initial painless bleeding only if the os is closed; on exam the os is open.
AS-1044F.D: السبب إنه غلط: Septic incomplete abortion needs infection signs: fever, foul smelling discharge, uterine tenderness, systemic upset. Her vitals are normal.

AS-1044G.A: السبب إنه غلط: Septic abortion presents with fever, foul smelling discharge and uterine tenderness, usually after instrumentation; none are described.
AS-1044G.B: السبب إنه غلط: Missed abortion has no fetal heartbeat (nonviable pregnancy) with a closed os; here the heartbeat is positive. Same scenario with absent heartbeat would be missed.
AS-1044G.C: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion requires an open os; this os is closed.

AS-1044H.A: السبب إنه غلط: Missed abortion has a closed os and a nonviable fetus; here the os is open and the fetus is viable.
AS-1044H.C: السبب إنه غلط: Incomplete abortion requires partial passage of tissue; nothing has been passed here.
AS-1044H.D: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion also has a viable fetus, but the os is closed; an open os moves it to inevitable.

AS-1044I.A: السبب إنه غلط: Missed abortion is a nonviable pregnancy (no heartbeat) with a closed os and usually no bleeding; this fetus is viable.
AS-1044I.B: السبب إنه غلط: Inevitable abortion needs an open cervix; this os is closed.
AS-1044I.D: السبب إنه غلط: Incomplete abortion needs tissue passage and an open os; neither is present.

AS-1052.A: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1052.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1055.A: السبب إنه غلط: Follow up alone ignores that pregnancy raises thyroxine requirement; under the rule this question follows, subclinical hypothyroidism is treated once she is pregnant, not just observed.
AS-1055.B: السبب إنه غلط: Starting thyroxine now (before conception) is the rule for overt disease or TSH above 10; with a subclinical picture the key is to start during pregnancy.
AS-1055.D: السبب إنه غلط: Proceeding with no plan leaves untreated subclinical hypothyroidism in pregnancy, which needs thyroxine once she conceives.

AS-1056.A: السبب إنه غلط: Tdap is also recommended in every pregnancy, but it is timed for later pregnancy (27 to 36 weeks), not the first booking visit.
AS-1056.C: السبب إنه غلط: Pneumococcal vaccine is given only for specific risk indications (e.g. asplenia, chronic disease), not routinely in pregnancy.
AS-1056.D: السبب إنه غلط: Meningococcal vaccine is given only for specific risk, outbreak or travel indications, not as a routine antenatal vaccine.

AS-1056B.B: السبب إنه غلط: MMR is a <bdi>live attenuated</bdi> vaccine and is contraindicated in pregnancy; it is given before conception or postpartum.
AS-1056B.C: السبب إنه غلط: DTaP is the paediatric formulation for young children; adults in pregnancy receive <bdi>Tdap</bdi>, and that is timed at 27 to 36 weeks.

AS-1056C.A: السبب إنه غلط: Rubella is a live attenuated vaccine, contraindicated once pregnant; it belongs to the preconception or postpartum period.
AS-1056C.B: السبب إنه غلط: Measles is a live attenuated vaccine (given as MMR) and is avoided in pregnancy.
AS-1056C.D: السبب إنه غلط: Varicella is a live attenuated vaccine and is avoided in pregnancy; a non-immune woman should avoid exposure and receive it after delivery.

AS-1056D.A: السبب إنه غلط: Inactivated influenza vaccine is safe and recommended in any trimester during flu season, but it is not tied to 28 weeks; when the stem stresses the gestational age, the timed vaccine is Tdap. Pick influenza when the stem gives an outbreak or flu season at a non-Tdap gestation.
AS-1056D.C: السبب إنه غلط: Iron is for documented anemia or as routine supplementation depending on local policy; with everything normal it is not the gestation-specific measure this stem is cueing.
AS-1056D.D: السبب إنه غلط: GBS prophylaxis is intrapartum IV antibiotics for a GBS-positive screen (late third trimester) or risk factors, not something given at 28 weeks; calcium is for low dietary calcium intake or preeclampsia risk reduction, neither present here.

AS-1056E.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1056E.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1056E.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1064.A: السبب إنه غلط: Missed miscarriage needs an intrauterine sac or embryo without cardiac activity on ultrasound; here no intrauterine sac is seen at all.
AS-1064.B: السبب إنه غلط: An ovarian ectopic needs a gestational sac or mass seen on or within the ovary; the scan shows no extrauterine sac, so you cannot name the site.
AS-1064.C: السبب إنه غلط: Complete abortion needs a previously confirmed intrauterine pregnancy with passage of tissue, a closed os and falling hCG; without a documented prior IUP an empty uterus is PUL, and ectopic is not excluded.

AS-1065.B: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine artery embolization is for a surgical candidate who refuses surgery; it is not the choice to improve fertility, as it can compromise the endometrium and ovarian supply.
AS-1065.C: السبب إنه غلط: A continuous progesterone regimen only controls bleeding symptoms, does not remove fibroids, and prevents conception while taken.
AS-1065.D: السبب إنه غلط: GnRH agonists shrink fibroids only temporarily as a pre-operative step; they suppress ovulation and the fibroids regrow on stopping, so they do not improve fertility alone.

AS-1079.A: السبب إنه غلط: Maternal vital signs are monitored in every labor and closely in hypertension, but the question asks about intrapartum fetal monitoring, which this does not provide.
AS-1079.B: السبب إنه غلط: Intermittent auscultation is the method for low-risk labors; hypertension and a growth-restricted fetus make her high risk.
AS-1079.D: السبب إنه غلط: Early identification of complications is the goal of monitoring, not a monitoring method; continuous CTG is how it is achieved here.

AS-1081.B: السبب إنه غلط: Gentamicin is a parenteral aminoglycoside with potential fetal oto and nephrotoxicity, reserved for severe infection such as pyelonephritis; it is not the choice for simple asymptomatic bacteriuria when a safe oral agent works.
AS-1081.C: السبب إنه غلط: Observation is right for asymptomatic bacteriuria in non-pregnant patients, but in pregnancy it must be treated because of the risk of pyelonephritis and preterm birth.

AS-1088.A: السبب إنه غلط: Muscle-strengthening exercise has no role in preventing preterm birth; it is general advice, not a targeted intervention.
AS-1088.B: السبب إنه غلط: Sending a high-risk woman with cramps and discharge home to self-monitor is unsafe; symptoms at 28 weeks need assessment for preterm labor (cervical exam), not delayed presentation.

AS-1091.A: السبب إنه غلط: Ultrasound is the next step, chosen and interpreted according to the pregnancy test (transvaginal if hCG positive); it is not the first test when pregnancy status is unknown.
AS-1091.B: السبب إنه غلط: Option not recalled; any preliminary set without a pregnancy test (for example CT first, or observation) would be wrong in a woman of reproductive age with pain and spotting.
AS-1091.D: السبب إنه غلط: CBC and renal function omit the pregnancy test, the single most important result in a reproductive-age woman with pain and bleeding; renal function adds little here.

AS-1096.A: السبب إنه غلط: A 24 hour urine protein is done to quantify proteinuria when hypertension or preeclampsia is suspected after 20 weeks; she is normotensive and asymptomatic.
AS-1096.B: السبب إنه غلط: Early GDM screening is for risk factors such as previous GDM or obesity; with no risk she is screened routinely at 24 to 28 weeks.
AS-1096.C: السبب إنه غلط: Low dose aspirin is for women with preeclampsia risk factors and is ideally started before 16 weeks; she has neither the indication nor the timing.

AS-1099.B: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine artery embolization is for a surgical candidate who declines surgery; nothing in the stem says she refuses.
AS-1099.C: السبب إنه غلط: A hormonal IUD is medical treatment, which has already failed, and a 7 cm fibroid can distort the cavity, making placement and retention unreliable.
AS-1099.D: السبب إنه غلط: Oral progesterone is also medical treatment; it will not control a 7 cm fibroid after medical therapy has failed.

AS-1099B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Endometrial ablation treats heavy bleeding from a normal-shaped cavity; a large fibroid <bdi>distorting the endometrial lining</bdi> makes ablation ineffective and technically unsuitable.
AS-1099B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine artery embolization is the alternative for a surgical candidate who <bdi>declines or is unfit for surgery</bdi>; nothing here says she refuses hysterectomy.
AS-1099B.D: السبب إنه غلط: A hormonal IUD is a medical option and medical therapy has already failed; a distorted cavity also makes placement and retention unreliable. It suits menorrhagia with a normal cavity.

AS-1100.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1100.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1100.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1105.A: السبب إنه غلط: A ruptured corpus luteum can bleed into the peritoneum, but the ovaries are reported normal, and with a positive test and no intrauterine sac a ruptured ectopic must be assumed.
AS-1105.B: السبب إنه غلط: An intact ectopic causes localized pain with little or no free fluid; a huge fluid collection and generalized pain mean rupture.
AS-1105.D: السبب إنه غلط: An early intrauterine pregnancy would not explain severe generalized pain with massive free fluid and no intrauterine sac.

AS-1107.A: السبب إنه غلط: Tocolysis is not recommended once membranes have ruptured; it does not improve outcome and may mask infection. Tocolytics plus steroids fit preterm labor with <bdi>intact</bdi> membranes.
AS-1107.B: السبب إنه غلط: Delivery is indicated in PPROM only for chorioamnionitis, abruption, non-reassuring CTG or cord prolapse risk, or at 34 weeks and beyond; at 31 weeks with a reassuring CTG it adds prematurity without benefit.

AS-1108.A: السبب إنه غلط: Informing NICU is reasonable, but simply anticipating delivery gives no steroids or tocolysis and wastes the chance to improve fetal lung maturity.
AS-1108.B: السبب إنه غلط: Incomplete: without a tocolytic, delivery may occur before the steroid course reaches its benefit.
AS-1108.D: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened preterm labor means contractions without cervical change; she has cervical dilation and effacement, so observation is wrong.

AS-1111.A: السبب إنه غلط: Suction curettage is for heavy bleeding, hemodynamic instability, infection, failed expectant or medical management, or patient preference; none apply here.
AS-1111.B: السبب إنه غلط: The prostaglandin used for medical management of miscarriage is misoprostol (PGE1); PGE2 is a cervical ripening agent for induction of labor, and expectant management is acceptable first.
AS-1111.D: السبب إنه غلط: There is no fever, tenderness or foul discharge, so antibiotics (septic abortion management) are not indicated.

AS-1112.A: السبب إنه غلط: Anesthesia is a consequence of an operative delivery, not a recognized independent maternal risk of going post-term.
AS-1112.B: السبب إنه غلط: Blood transfusion may follow a hemorrhage but is not a listed maternal risk of post-term pregnancy in itself.
AS-1112.C: السبب إنه غلط: Placenta previa is a cause of antepartum bleeding and is delivered by elective cesarean at 36 to 37 weeks; it is linked to early, not post-term, delivery.

AS-1113.A: السبب إنه غلط: Misoprostol is a second-line uterotonic (useful for atonic PPH when oxytocin is unavailable); it has not been shown to help deliver a retained placenta.
AS-1113.B: السبب إنه غلط: Carboprost is a later-line drug for atonic PPH (contraindicated in asthma); it is not used to expel a retained placenta.

AS-1119.A: السبب إنه غلط: Tdap is recommended in every pregnancy, at 27 to 36 weeks, so maternal antibodies protect the newborn from pertussis.
AS-1119.B: السبب إنه غلط: Inactivated influenza vaccine is recommended in any trimester because flu is more severe in pregnancy; only the live intranasal form is avoided.
AS-1119.D: السبب إنه غلط: COVID vaccination is recommended in pregnancy because infection carries higher maternal and fetal risk.

AS-1120.A: السبب إنه غلط: Tdap (whooping cough) is recommended in every pregnancy at 27 to 36 weeks to protect the newborn.
AS-1120.B: السبب إنه غلط: Inactivated influenza vaccine is recommended in pregnancy in any trimester.
AS-1120.C: السبب إنه غلط: HPV is not live; it is deferred until after pregnancy because of limited data, not truly contraindicated. It becomes the answer only in the variant where no live vaccine is listed.

AS-1133.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1134.A: السبب إنه غلط: Acetaminophen has no anti-prostaglandin effect, so it is a weak option for severe, work-limiting dysmenorrhea; acceptable only for mild pain or when other drugs are contraindicated.
AS-1134.C: السبب إنه غلط: Progestin-only pills are not the standard treatment for primary dysmenorrhea; they suit women needing contraception with a contraindication to estrogen.

AS-1138.B: السبب إنه غلط: Salpingectomy is for a ruptured or unstable ectopic, a large mass, contraindication to methotrexate, or failed medical treatment; none applies here.
AS-1138.C: السبب إنه غلط: Salpingostomy is also surgery, chosen at laparoscopy to preserve the tube (needs hCG follow-up); it is not first choice when methotrexate criteria are met.
AS-1138.D: السبب إنه غلط: D&C evacuates intrauterine tissue in miscarriage; the uterus is empty and does not treat an ectopic.

AS-1144.A: السبب إنه غلط: Misoprostol is a second-line uterotonic for atonic PPH; it has not been shown to help deliver a retained placenta.
AS-1144.C: السبب إنه غلط: Carboprost is a later-line drug for atonic PPH (avoid in asthma), not a treatment for retained placenta.
AS-1144.D: السبب إنه غلط: Ergometrine causes sustained uterine contraction that can close the cervix and trap the placenta; it is also contraindicated in hypertension.

AS-1147.A: السبب إنه غلط: Losartan: an ARB is fetotoxic (fetal renal damage, oligohydramnios) and contraindicated in pregnancy. Right for HFrEF in a non-pregnant patient, or postpartum.
AS-1147.B: السبب إنه غلط: Lisinopril: ACE inhibitors carry the same fetal renal toxicity and are contraindicated in pregnancy. It is the standard HFrEF drug outside pregnancy, and is restarted after delivery.
AS-1147.C: السبب إنه غلط: Methyldopa: a central antihypertensive used for chronic or mild hypertension in pregnancy; it does not unload the failing ventricle and has no role in treating heart failure.

AS-1150.A: السبب إنه غلط: Antibiotics with anaesthesia: prophylactic antibiotics are given before skin incision and confirmed at the time-out step; they matter, but they are not the safety item that must be secured before induction.
AS-1150.B: السبب إنه غلط: Blood glucose monitor: relevant only for a diabetic patient or one on insulin; nothing in the stem mentions diabetes.

AS-1156.A: السبب إنه غلط: IM carboprost: PGF2 alpha is a bronchoconstrictor and is contraindicated in bronchial asthma. It is the right next drug when methylergonovine is barred, e.g. in a hypertensive or preeclamptic woman.
AS-1156.C: السبب إنه غلط: Balloon tamponade: the next step after vaginal delivery only once medical (uterotonic) treatment has failed; a second-line uterotonic has not been tried yet.
AS-1156.D: السبب إنه غلط: This option is garbled in the recall (100%, possibly 100% oxygen); oxygen is supportive resuscitation and does not stop atonic bleeding.

AS-1158.B: السبب إنه غلط: Abdominal CT: exposes a possibly pregnant woman to radiation and is less suited than ultrasound with Doppler for adnexal causes such as torsion or ectopic pregnancy. Right once pregnancy is excluded and ultrasound is inconclusive, e.g. an obese adult with suspected appendicitis.
AS-1158.C: السبب إنه غلط: Diagnostic laparoscopy: invasive; used when imaging is inconclusive and suspicion stays high, or for an unstable patient or strongly suspected torsion needing surgery anyway.
AS-1158.D: السبب إنه غلط: Colonoscopy: no role in acute abdominal pain and risks perforation if appendicitis is present; it is for chronic bowel symptoms or bleeding.

AS-1184.B: السبب إنه غلط: Exercise: more energy expenditure worsens the deficit; excessive exercise is itself a cause of hypothalamic amenorrhoea (athlete triad).
AS-1184.C: السبب إنه غلط: Vitamins: correct micronutrient deficiencies but do not restore the energy and fat reserve needed to switch GnRH back on.
AS-1184.D: السبب إنه غلط: Sleep hygiene: useful for general wellbeing but has no role in reversing underweight-related amenorrhoea.

AS-1192.A: السبب إنه غلط: Folate deficiency: only a weak, historical association with abruption; its main obstetric link is neural tube defects and anaemia.
AS-1192.B: السبب إنه غلط: Short umbilical cord: a rare mechanical cause (traction on the placenta during descent), not a common one.
AS-1192.D: السبب إنه غلط: Premature rupture of membranes: a recognised risk factor (as is sudden uterine decompression), but much less common than hypertension.

AS-1195.A: السبب إنه غلط: Complete bed rest: no proven benefit in preventing preeclampsia and increases the risk of venous thromboembolism.
AS-1195.C: السبب إنه غلط: Restrict calcium intake: the opposite of the evidence; calcium supplementation (not restriction) lowers preeclampsia risk in women with low dietary calcium intake.
AS-1195.D: السبب إنه غلط: Increase sodium intake: has no preventive effect and would not be advised in a woman at risk of hypertension.

AS-1196.B: السبب إنه غلط: Ibuprofen: NSAIDs are not used here and risk premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus and oligohydramnios; indomethacin is the NSAID occasionally used as a tocolytic in early preterm labour.
AS-1196.C: السبب إنه غلط: Antibiotics: are indeed given in PPROM (e.g. ampicillin plus erythromycin) to prevent infection and prolong latency, but they do not prevent RDS.
AS-1196.D: السبب إنه غلط: Paracetamol: an analgesic and antipyretic only; no effect on fetal lung maturity.

AS-1197.A: السبب إنه غلط: NRT is first line for non pregnant smokers, but in pregnancy it is added only after counselling alone has not worked; it still delivers nicotine to the fetus.
AS-1197.C: السبب إنه غلط: Telling her to stop abruptly with no support has the lowest success rate and abandons her; quitting should be encouraged, but always with structured support.
AS-1197.D: السبب إنه غلط: Option text missing in this recall. Another version listed non nicotine chewing gum, which is not an evidence based cessation therapy; bupropion and varenicline are generally avoided in pregnancy.

AS-1205.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1205.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1211.B: السبب إنه غلط: 2000 mg is about double the accepted total requirement for a singleton pregnancy.
AS-1211.C: السبب إنه غلط: 3000 mg greatly overestimates the requirement; it exceeds the total body iron of most adult women.
AS-1211.D: السبب إنه غلط: 4000 mg is far above any physiological need and is not a quoted figure for pregnancy.

AS-1214.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1214.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1214.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1218.A: السبب إنه غلط: 1 to 6% is close to the background population rate; it underestimates the recurrence risk after a previous ectopic.
AS-1218.B: السبب إنه غلط: 7 to 10% falls mostly below the quoted 10 to 15% band and only touches its lower edge; 15% is the better fit among these options.
AS-1218.D: السبب إنه غلط: 20% overestimates the risk after one ectopic; risks above 25% are quoted after <bdi>two or more</bdi> previous ectopics.

AS-1222.A: السبب إنه غلط: Endometritis: usually follows delivery, miscarriage or instrumentation with fever and discharge, and the biopsy would show inflammation (plasma cells); here the biopsy is normal.
AS-1222.B: السبب إنه غلط: Endometriosis: causes secondary dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia and infertility but the uterus is usually normal in size; choose it when dysmenorrhea comes with infertility or an adnexal (chocolate) cyst.
AS-1222.D: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine sarcoma: a rapidly enlarging, often postmenopausal mass, not a long history of progressive painful heavy periods with a symmetric tender uterus.

AS-1223.B: السبب إنه غلط: Oophorectomy removes the whole ovary unnecessarily in a 20-year-old; it fits a nonsalvageable ovary or postmenopausal women.
AS-1223.C: السبب إنه غلط: Review is only for simple, asymptomatic masses of 5 cm or less; this one is complex and 6 cm.
AS-1223.D: السبب إنه غلط: Aspiration of a complex or solid mass is non-diagnostic, recurs and risks spilling malignant cells; it has no role here.

AS-1225.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1225.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1228.A: السبب إنه غلط: Sending her away for a week with no monitoring and planning induction only at 42 weeks leaves a late term fetus unsurveilled; if she wants to wait, monitoring must happen in the meantime.
AS-1228.B: السبب إنه غلط: Discharge without a plan ignores the rising risks after 41 weeks; it would be right only in a normal term pregnancy before 41 weeks.
AS-1228.D: السبب إنه غلط: Post term pregnancy alone is not an indication for cesarean; the route of delivery is induction of labor unless there is another obstetric indication.

AS-1232.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1235.A: السبب إنه غلط: Keeping the same dose until the third trimester misses the early rise in requirement and risks maternal hypothyroidism during fetal brain development; TSH needs checking every few weeks in the first half of pregnancy.
AS-1235.C: السبب إنه غلط: Stopping levothyroxine is never appropriate in pregnancy; maternal hypothyroidism is linked to miscarriage and impaired fetal neurodevelopment.
AS-1235.D: السبب إنه غلط: Liothyronine (T3) does not cross the placenta well enough to supply fetal T4; levothyroxine remains the drug of choice in pregnancy.

AS-1237.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1237.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1238B.A: السبب إنه غلط: 0.2 mg is below the effective preventive dose for neural tube defects; no guideline uses it for pregnancy.
AS-1238B.C: السبب إنه غلط: 1.4 mg is not a recognised regimen: too much for average risk and far short of the high dose (4 to 5 mg) used for high risk women.
AS-1238B.D: السبب إنه غلط: 2.4 mg is also not a standard regimen; a high risk woman (previous NTD, antiepileptics, sickle cell disease, diabetes, obesity) would get 4 to 5 mg instead.

AS-1240.A: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine massage is a treatment step once the uterus is found soft and boggy (atony); sustained massage is not recommended as prophylaxis when oxytocin has been given.
AS-1240.C: السبب إنه غلط: Delayed cord clamping (1 to 3 minutes) is recommended for neonatal benefit (iron stores), but it does not reduce maternal blood loss.
AS-1240.D: السبب إنه غلط: The recalled option is a cord manoeuvre (likely cord milking or traction); cord handling at most slightly affects maternal blood loss, while the uterotonic is the component that actually prevents PPH.

AS-1253.B: السبب إنه غلط: Flexibility and mobility work (stretching) is fine for general fitness but has little evidence for relieving PMS symptoms compared with aerobic activity.

AS-1253B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Flexibility and resistance training can help general fitness, but it is not the exercise type taught as recommended for dysmenorrhea.
AS-1253B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Stability (core balance) exercise is used in rehabilitation and back pain programs, not as the standard advice for menstrual pain.
AS-1253B.D: السبب إنه غلط: Agility training is sport specific skill work and has no role in managing dysmenorrhea.

AS-1254.A: السبب إنه غلط: TSH is part of the second tier workup of amenorrhea (thyroid disease), done only after a negative pregnancy test.
AS-1254.B: السبب إنه غلط: FSH separates ovarian failure from hypothalamic causes, but it is meaningful only once pregnancy has been ruled out.
AS-1254.D: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic ultrasound comes after a positive test (to locate and date the pregnancy) or for structural causes; it is not the first test.

AS-1264.B: السبب إنه غلط: Once pregnancy is known, imaging should not continue as for a non pregnant patient; it must be justified, use the lowest dose possible, or be replaced by ultrasound or MRI.
AS-1264.C: السبب إنه غلط: Indefinitely deferring needed imaging is wrong; it leaves the mother's condition undiagnosed, and the exposure that already happened is not undone by deferral.
AS-1264.D: السبب إنه غلط: Image quality regardless of dose breaks the ALARA principle (as low as reasonably achievable), which matters most in pregnancy.

AS-1274.A: السبب إنه غلط: Propylthiouracil is an antithyroid drug for hyperthyroidism (the first trimester choice in Graves disease); it would worsen hypothyroidism.
AS-1274.B: السبب إنه غلط: Multivitamins do not replace thyroid hormone and will not correct the deficiency.
AS-1274.D: السبب إنه غلط: Thyroidectomy is for hyperthyroidism or goitre not controlled medically; it would cause, not treat, hypothyroidism.

AS-1282.A: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic MRI has no role in first trimester bleeding; it is slow and costly and adds nothing over TVUS.
AS-1282.C: السبب إنه غلط: Serial beta hCG at 48 hours is for a pregnancy of unknown location after a nondiagnostic TVUS, not the first step with an open os.
AS-1282.D: السبب إنه غلط: Waiting 10 days is unsafe; an open os with bleeding is an ongoing miscarriage that needs assessment now.

AS-1283.A: السبب إنه غلط: IVF first is right for bilateral tubal blockage, severe male factor or failed ovulation induction; none is present here, and obesity should be addressed first.

AS-1291.A: السبب إنه غلط: Methotrexate is never given before an ectopic is confirmed (it could end a viable intrauterine pregnancy), and an hCG of 16000 is above the level where methotrexate is suitable.
AS-1291.B: السبب إنه غلط: Repeating hCG at 48 hours is the step for a pregnancy of unknown location while hCG is still low; here the rising trend is already known and well above the discriminatory zone, so another hCG adds nothing.
AS-1291.D: السبب إنه غلط: Reassurance is unsafe until the pregnancy is seen inside the uterus; ectopic has not been excluded.

AS-1292.A: السبب إنه غلط: Amniotomy is only one step of induction, used when the cervix is already favourable and the head engaged; here the cervix is 1 cm, fluid is low and the fetus is compromised.
AS-1292.C: السبب إنه غلط: Induction is the right answer for the same term pre-eclamptic with a reassuring fetus (the sister card without the Doppler finding); absent end-diastolic flow makes a trial of labour unsafe.
AS-1292.D: السبب إنه غلط: Waiting has no role at term in pre-eclampsia with severe-range BP; delivery is the cure and delay risks eclampsia, HELLP, abruption and fetal death.

AS-1293.A: السبب إنه غلط: Amniotomy is one method within induction, suitable once the cervix is favourable and the head engaged; at 1 cm with low fluid, ripening and oxytocin come first, so 'induction' is the better overall answer.
AS-1293.B: السبب إنه غلط: Pre-eclampsia alone is not an indication for caesarean; CS is chosen when there is fetal compromise (e.g. absent end-diastolic flow, as in the sister card), non-reassuring CTG or malpresentation.
AS-1293.D: السبب إنه غلط: Expectant care is wrong at term with severe-range BP; delivery is the only cure and waiting risks eclampsia, HELLP and abruption.

AS-1306.A: السبب إنه غلط: Family history (e.g. endometriosis in a mother or sister) is supportive only; it does not characterise her pain.
AS-1306.B: السبب إنه غلط: Medical history matters for drug choice (e.g. NSAID contraindications) but does not distinguish primary from secondary dysmenorrhea.
AS-1306.C: السبب إنه غلط: Surgical history helps when adhesions or previous pelvic surgery are suspected, but it is secondary to the menstrual pattern itself.

AS-1322.B: السبب إنه غلط: Delaying care is the opposite of advice; booking should be in the first trimester (dating scan, screening bloods), with visits every 4 weeks until 28 weeks, every 2 weeks until 36, then weekly.
AS-1322.C: السبب إنه غلط: Healthy pregnant women are encouraged to stay active with regular moderate exercise; avoiding activity offers no benefit and promotes excess weight gain.
AS-1322.D: السبب إنه غلط: This option was not recorded by the recaller, so it cannot be judged; the key remains nutrition with iron and folic acid.

AS-1324.B: السبب إنه غلط: There is no reason to avoid pregnancy; most small fibroids cause no problem, and avoiding pregnancy would be harmful advice.
AS-1324.C: السبب إنه غلط: Myomectomy is for symptomatic or large fibroids, failed medical treatment, or a cavity-distorting (submucosal) fibroid causing infertility; operating on a 2 cm subserosal fibroid adds uterine scarring with no benefit.
AS-1324.D: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy ends fertility and is for symptomatic women who have completed their family; it is clearly wrong for a woman planning pregnancy.

AS-1335.A: السبب إنه غلط: CTG assesses fetal wellbeing in the third trimester or in labour; it does not measure growth and has no role at 20 weeks.
AS-1335.B: السبب إنه غلط: BPP is a wellbeing test used once FGR is established or in late pregnancy surveillance; it does not screen for growth restriction.
AS-1335.D: السبب إنه غلط: Umbilical artery Doppler is the key monitoring test once a small fetus is found (absent or reversed flow guides delivery timing), but it is not the primary screening tool in a currently normal pregnancy.

AS-1361.A: السبب إنه غلط: A spontaneous vaginal delivery by itself is not an indication for antibiotic prophylaxis.
AS-1361.B: السبب إنه غلط: Membranes ruptured only about 5 hours before delivery is not prolonged rupture; prolonged rupture (classically ≥18 hours) is what raises infection and GBS concern.
AS-1361.C: السبب إنه غلط: A 2nd degree tear (perineal muscle, sphincter intact) is repaired without antibiotics; prophylaxis is given for 3rd and 4th degree (anal sphincter or rectal mucosa) tears.

AS-1369.A: السبب إنه غلط: Her vital signs are normal; instability would favour surgery (as an absolute contraindication to methotrexate), but here they argue for, not against, medical treatment.
AS-1369.B: السبب إنه غلط: hCG 5000 still meets the methotrexate criterion (≤5000), so it does not push her to surgery; only a level above the cutoff would make hCG the deciding factor.
AS-1369.D: السبب إنه غلط: A 4 cm mass without fetal cardiac activity is at the size limit and is a relative factor; a larger mass, fetal heartbeat or free fluid would make ultrasound the deciding feature.

AS-1395.B: السبب إنه غلط: 18 weeks is too late for a history-indicated stitch; from 15 to 23 weeks the approach is serial transvaginal cervical length, and cerclage is placed only if the cervix shortens below 25 mm (ultrasound-indicated) before 24 weeks.

AS-1399.B: السبب إنه غلط: Vaginal ultrasound images the endometrium and adnexa; it would be the right first test for suspected uterine or adnexal pathology (e.g. a pelvic mass or AUB workup), but it cannot exclude a cervical lesion causing contact bleeding.

AS-1400.A: السبب إنه غلط: Losartan is an ARB; ARBs are fetotoxic (fetal renal damage, oligohydramnios) and contraindicated in pregnancy. They become an option for HF only after delivery.
AS-1400.B: السبب إنه غلط: Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor, contraindicated in pregnancy for the same fetal renal effects; after delivery an ACE inhibitor replaces hydralazine/nitrates for PPCM.
AS-1400.D: السبب إنه غلط: Methyldopa is an antihypertensive for chronic or gestational hypertension; it has no role in reducing afterload or improving outcomes in heart failure.

AS-1402.A: السبب إنه غلط: FSH confirms menopause or POI and would be the key test once pregnancy is excluded; it is the second step here, not the first.
AS-1402.B: السبب إنه غلط: Thyroid tests (TSH) are part of the second tier of amenorrhea workup (with prolactin) after a negative pregnancy test; thyroid disease can mimic fatigue and sweating but is not checked first.
AS-1402.D: السبب إنه غلط: Estradiol level is not a reliable first-line test; it fluctuates and adds little once FSH is measured, and it does not exclude pregnancy.

AS-1404.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1404.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1410.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1410.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1428.A: السبب إنه غلط: Surgery is for a rising hCG between day 4 and day 7, rupture, hemodynamic instability or failure after a second dose; none is present here.
AS-1428.C: السبب إنه غلط: Observation alone is correct only when hCG falls by more than 15% from day 4 to day 7; then weekly hCG until undetectable.

AS-1435B.A: السبب إنه غلط: Endometrial cancer comes from unopposed estrogen (obesity, PCOS, diabetes, anovulation); POI is hypoestrogenic, and the stem stresses no diabetes or obesity.
AS-1435B.B: السبب إنه غلط: Multiple gestation is a risk of ovulation induction or IVF; in ovarian failure fertility is markedly reduced.
AS-1435B.C: السبب إنه غلط: Ovarian cancer risk rises with incessant ovulation (nulliparity, BRCA); a failed ovary that no longer ovulates does not raise it.

AS-1438.B: السبب إنه غلط: Atenolol is avoided in pregnancy because it is associated with fetal growth restriction; the beta-blocker of choice is labetalol.
AS-1438.C: السبب إنه غلط: Captopril is an ACE inhibitor; ACE inhibitors are fetotoxic (renal dysgenesis, oligohydramnios) and contraindicated in pregnancy.
AS-1438.D: السبب إنه غلط: Losartan is an ARB, contraindicated in pregnancy for the same fetal renal toxicity as ACE inhibitors.

AS-1461.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1461.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1463.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1463.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1463.D: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1470.B: السبب إنه غلط: Carbimazole is an antithyroid drug for hyperthyroidism (low TSH) and would worsen hypothyroidism; it is also avoided in the first trimester because of embryopathy, where PTU is preferred.
AS-1470.C: السبب إنه غلط: Iodine supplementation prevents deficiency in at risk populations but does not treat established hypothyroidism with a raised TSH; radioactive iodine is absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy.
AS-1470.D: السبب إنه غلط: Surgery is for a compressive goiter, suspected malignancy or hyperthyroidism failing drugs; it does not correct hypothyroidism and would leave her needing thyroxine anyway.

AS-1472.A: السبب إنه غلط: Reassurance is unsafe: bleeding in a high risk woman with a non diagnostic biopsy has not excluded cancer. It is right only after a benign tissue diagnosis.
AS-1472.C: السبب إنه غلط: Hysterectomy without a diagnosis is premature; it is right once cancer or atypical hyperplasia is confirmed (with staging) or for refractory benign disease.
AS-1472.D: السبب إنه غلط: Ultrasound is the first test before sampling, but on tamoxifen the endometrium often looks thick and cystic, so it cannot exclude cancer; after an inadequate biopsy in a symptomatic patient tissue is still needed.

AS-1479.B: السبب إنه غلط: Endometriosis usually leaves a normal sized uterus; it would fit with dyspareunia, infertility, a fixed retroverted uterus, uterosacral nodules or an adnexal chocolate cyst.
AS-1479.C: السبب إنه غلط: Fibroids give an irregularly enlarged, firm, non tender uterus with heavy bleeding; they would fit a lumpy uterus on examination rather than a diffusely bulky, painful one.

AS-1480.B: السبب إنه غلط: Endometriosis usually has a normal sized uterus; it fits dyspareunia, infertility, fixed retroversion or an endometrioma, none of which is described.
AS-1480.C: السبب إنه غلط: Fibroids cause an irregularly enlarged, firm uterus that is usually not tender; the tender, diffusely bulky uterus here points away from them despite the prior myomectomy.
AS-1480.D: السبب إنه غلط: Endometrial cancer typically presents as postmenopausal bleeding in an older woman with obesity, diabetes or hypertension; this woman is still cycling regularly with painful clotted periods and a tender uterus. Her BMI of 40 is a real risk factor (so AUB over 45 still warrants endometrial sampling), but it does not explain the picture here.

AS-1481.A: السبب إنه غلط: Endometriosis is ectopic endometrium outside the uterus; it gives dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, dyschezia and infertility with a normal sized uterus, and menorrhagia is not its leading feature.
AS-1481.C: السبب إنه غلط: Fibroids cause menorrhagia mainly when submucosal (or large intramural), and ultrasound would show a discrete myometrial or submucosal mass with an irregular, firm enlarged uterus; it would be right if the scan showed such a mass.

AS-1492.B: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.
AS-1492.C: خيار غير مطابق لمعطيات السؤال الأساسية المذكورة بالفكرة فوق.

AS-1494.A: السبب إنه غلط: Flucloxacillin is an anti staphylococcal penicillin for skin and soft tissue infection (cellulitis, impetigo); it does not reliably cover gram negative urinary pathogens.
AS-1494.C: السبب إنه غلط: Ciprofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone and is avoided in pregnancy at every stage; it would be right for complicated UTI in a non pregnant adult.
AS-1494.D: السبب إنه غلط: Nitrofurantoin is first line for uncomplicated cystitis in non pregnant women; in pregnancy this source treats it as relatively contraindicated (avoid near term, caution in the first trimester), so the key picks a beta lactam instead.

AS-1841.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin is a peptide inactivated in the gut, so it is never given orally; it is given IV or IM.
AS-1841.B: السبب إنه غلط: Ergometrine causes vasoconstriction and BP surges, so it is contraindicated in preeclampsia whatever the route; it would be a second-line option in a normotensive woman.
AS-1841.C: السبب إنه غلط: IM ergometrine has the same contraindication in hypertension; changing route or dose does not make it safe here.

AS-1857.A: السبب إنه غلط: Hematocrit falls in pregnancy because of hemodilution; it does not rise.
AS-1857.B: السبب إنه غلط: The direction is right but the size is wrong: hematocrit falls only modestly (physiological dilutional anemia). The 40 to 45% figure belongs to blood volume.
AS-1857.C: السبب إنه غلط: This underestimates the rise; total blood volume increases by about 40 to 45%, not 20 to 25%.

AS-1858.A: السبب إنه غلط: Coagulopathy (DIC) is the classic complication of placental abruption with concealed bleeding, not of previa.
AS-1858.B: السبب إنه غلط: Previa bleeding is characteristically painless; painful bleeding with a tender uterus points to abruption.
AS-1858.D: السبب إنه غلط: The first (sentinel) previa bleed is usually small and stops spontaneously; heavy bleeding tends to come with later episodes.

AS-1859.B: السبب إنه غلط: Complete breech has BOTH hips and knees flexed (fetus sits cross legged); here the knees are extended.
AS-1859.C: السبب إنه غلط: Compound presentation means a limb (usually a hand) prolapses alongside the presenting part; it is not defined by hip and knee posture, and the arms here are simply flexed.
AS-1859.D: السبب إنه غلط: Incomplete (footling) breech has one or both hips extended so a foot or knee is lowermost; here both hips are flexed.

AS-1860.A: السبب إنه غلط: Endometrial cancer is the most <bdi>important</bdi> cause to exclude with TVUS and sampling, but it accounts for only a minority of postmenopausal bleeding; pick it when risk factors (obesity, diabetes, nulliparity) or a bulky uterus are given.
AS-1860.B: السبب إنه غلط: Polyps are a recognized cause but less common than atrophy.
AS-1860.D: السبب إنه غلط: Fibroids regress after menopause and rarely cause postmenopausal bleeding.

AS-1861.A: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic CT: gives no histology of the endometrium; used for staging once cancer is confirmed.
AS-1861.B: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic MRI: assesses local extent (myometrial invasion) after a tissue diagnosis; it is not the first diagnostic step.
AS-1861.C: السبب إنه غلط: Hysteroscopy: right when office sampling is inadequate, nondiagnostic, or bleeding persists, or when a focal lesion such as a polyp is suspected. Office sampling comes first.

AS-1862.B: السبب إنه غلط: Quantitative hCG confirms pregnancy and is used to follow early pregnancy or pregnancy of unknown location, but values vary too widely to date a pregnancy.
AS-1862.C: السبب إنه غلط: Waiting gains nothing; first-trimester crown-rump length is the most accurate dating parameter, so delaying only reduces precision.
AS-1862.D: السبب إنه غلط: The date a home test turned positive reflects when she happened to test, not conception or the LMP, so it cannot date the pregnancy.

AS-1863.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin is a uterotonic for induction/augmentation of labour and atonic postpartum haemorrhage; it has no effect on trophoblast outside the uterus.
AS-1863.B: السبب إنه غلط: Carboprost (PGF2 alpha) is a second-line uterotonic for atonic PPH and is avoided in asthma; it does not treat ectopic pregnancy.
AS-1863.C: السبب إنه غلط: Misoprostol (PGE1) is used for medical management of missed or incomplete miscarriage, cervical ripening and PPH; it expels intrauterine tissue, not a tubal pregnancy.

AS-1864.A: السبب إنه غلط: Uncrossmatched O negative blood is reserved for massive hemorrhage with instability when cross matched blood is not yet available; nothing here says she is in shock.
AS-1864.B: السبب إنه غلط: Sending blood tests and waiting for results delays resuscitation; labs are drawn in parallel, not as the first management step.
AS-1864.C: السبب إنه غلط: Surgery comes only after failed medical treatment (uterotonics) and balloon tamponade; it is not the initial step.

AS-1865.B: السبب إنه غلط: 20 weeks is the time of the anomaly scan and cervical length screening, not bacteriuria screening; it is too late to be the recommended window.
AS-1865.C: السبب إنه غلط: 26 weeks falls in the 24 to 28 week window for gestational diabetes screening, not bacteriuria.
AS-1865.D: السبب إنه غلط: 30 weeks is third trimester; bacteriuria is treated if found then, but screening is not timed there.

AS-1866.A: السبب إنه غلط: Abdominal X-ray: exposes the fetus to radiation and gives no information about the pregnancy; it fits bowel obstruction or perforation.
AS-1866.B: السبب إنه غلط: MRI of the pelvis: not a first-line test in early pregnancy bleeding; reserved for problem solving such as placenta accreta or complex masses.
AS-1866.D: السبب إنه غلط: CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis: a staging study (for example metastatic choriocarcinoma after a diagnosis), not an initial test, and carries high radiation dose.

AS-1867.B: السبب إنه غلط: 1000 is not a standard dose; extra anti-D is given only when a quantified fetomaternal hemorrhage exceeds what 300 micrograms covers.
AS-1867.C: السبب إنه غلط: 2000 is not a standard dose; larger amounts are calculated from a measured fetomaternal hemorrhage, not given routinely.
AS-1867.D: السبب إنه غلط: The 28-week prophylaxis does not replace the postpartum dose; it would only be unnecessary if the baby were Rh-negative or she were already sensitized.

AS-1868.A: السبب إنه غلط: Cryoprecipitate replaces fibrinogen (and factor VIII); it is used when fibrinogen is low, as in obstetric DIC after abruption, not in ITP.
AS-1868.B: السبب إنه غلط: Fresh frozen plasma replaces clotting factors (raised PT/INR, as in liver disease or warfarin); ITP has normal coagulation factors.
AS-1868.C: السبب إنه غلط: Packed red cells restore oxygen carrying capacity in major blood loss but do not correct the platelet defect causing the bleeding.

AS-1869.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oral fluconazole is first line outside pregnancy but is avoided in pregnancy because of possible fetal risk.
AS-1869.B: السبب إنه غلط: Topical antivirals treat genital herpes, which gives painful vesicles and ulcers rather than curdy discharge.
AS-1869.C: السبب إنه غلط: Topical estrogen treats atrophic vaginitis in postmenopausal women (thin pale mucosa, little discharge), not a fungal infection.

AS-1870.A: السبب إنه غلط: Vaginal inspection: shows only visible surfaces (vulva, vagina, cervix) and cannot assess the size, mobility or tenderness of the pelvic organs.
AS-1870.B: السبب إنه غلط: General appearance: non-specific and of low diagnostic value for pelvic pathology.
AS-1870.C: السبب إنه غلط: Abdominal examination: detects only large pelvic masses that rise into the abdomen; it cannot evaluate the cervix, uterus and adnexa in detail.

AS-1872.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin increases contraction stress on an already compromised fetus and is contraindicated in fetal distress; contractions are already strong at 4 in 10.
AS-1872.B: السبب إنه غلط: Full dilatation alone is not enough; instrumental delivery needs the head at +2 or lower. It would be right with the same CTG and the head at +2 or +3.
AS-1872.D: السبب إنه غلط: Reassurance fits a reassuring CTG; leaving a bradycardic fetus with late decelerations risks hypoxic injury.

AS-1873.A: السبب إنه غلط: A prolonged deceleration of this length is not reassuring; observation would be right only for a reassuring CTG.
AS-1873.B: السبب إنه غلط: Contractions are already regular and strong, and oxytocin would worsen fetal compromise; it is for inadequate contractions with a reassuring CTG.
AS-1873.D: السبب إنه غلط: Cesarean is the route when the head is high or the cervix is not fully dilated; with the head at +3 and full dilatation, instrumental delivery is quicker.

AS-1874.A: السبب إنه غلط: Oxytocin would increase contraction stress and worsen fetal distress; contractions are already adequate.
AS-1874.B: السبب إنه غلط: Forceps need full dilatation and the head at +2 or lower; she is only 7 cm.
AS-1874.D: السبب إنه غلط: Reassurance fits a reassuring CTG; with poor variability and recurrent decelerations it leaves the fetus at risk of hypoxia.

AS-1875.B: السبب إنه غلط: Chemotherapy is not used for a premalignant lesion; it is reserved for advanced or metastatic endometrial cancer.
AS-1875.C: السبب إنه غلط: Radiotherapy treats established endometrial cancer (adjuvant or primary when inoperable), not atypical hyperplasia.
AS-1875.D: السبب إنه غلط: Progesterone is first line for hyperplasia without atypia, or for atypia only when fertility is desired or surgery is impossible; neither applies at 50.

AS-1876.B: السبب إنه غلط: Alpha-fetoprotein is the marker for neural tube defects, yolk sac tumor and hepatocellular carcinoma, not trophoblastic disease.
AS-1876.C: السبب إنه غلط: CA 125 is raised in epithelial ovarian cancer (and benign pelvic conditions); a snowstorm uterus is not an ovarian process.
AS-1876.D: السبب إنه غلط: CEA is a marker for colorectal and other gastrointestinal or mucinous tumors and has no role in molar pregnancy.

AS-1879.A: السبب إنه غلط: Observation is expectant management, which is contraindicated after eclampsia.
AS-1879.B: السبب إنه غلط: Discharge is unsafe; eclampsia needs inpatient stabilization and delivery.
AS-1879.C: السبب إنه غلط: Prolonging pregnancy to 37 weeks is not acceptable in eclampsia; waiting to term applies only to gestational hypertension or pre-eclampsia without severe features.

AS-1880.B: السبب إنه غلط: Examination under anesthesia does not image the uterine cavity; it is used for assessing pelvic or cervical pathology, not a focal intracavitary lesion.
AS-1880.C: السبب إنه غلط: MRI is costly and not first line for a focal cavity lesion; it is reserved for mapping complex fibroids or suspected adenomyosis when ultrasound is inconclusive.
AS-1880.D: السبب إنه غلط: Coagulation screening is for heavy bleeding since menarche or without a structural cause; here a structural lesion has already been found in a healthy woman.

AS-1881.A: السبب إنه غلط: Cervical fibroids are rare; they cause local pressure effects (urinary or bowel symptoms, obstructed labor) rather than heavy menstrual bleeding.
AS-1881.B: السبب إنه غلط: Subserosal fibroids grow outward and cause pressure or heaviness but typically NOT menorrhagia, so they do not explain her bleeding.
AS-1881.D: السبب إنه غلط: Submucosal fibroids are the classic cause of menorrhagia and infertility; pick them when bleeding dominates without marked bulk symptoms such as leg edema.

AS-1882.A: السبب إنه غلط: Pelvic imaging does not reveal the chromosomal cause of ovarian insufficiency; MRI would be chosen for a structural pelvic question.
AS-1882.B: السبب إنه غلط: TSH is part of a general oligomenorrhea screen, but with an ovarian failure lab pattern the important test is karyotype.
AS-1882.C: السبب إنه غلط: Hyperprolactinemia gives low or normal FSH/LH, not the high gonadotropins of ovarian failure; choose prolactin if galactorrhea or low gonadotropins are shown.

AS-1883.A: السبب إنه غلط: Ovarian torsion: ovarian stimulation can enlarge the ovaries and predispose to torsion, so it is a real differential, but a positive pregnancy test after embryo transfer with severe pain points first to ectopic. Torsion fits sudden unilateral pain with vomiting and an adnexal mass.
AS-1883.C: السبب إنه غلط: Acute appendicitis: periumbilical pain migrating to the right iliac fossa with fever and anorexia; it has no link to embryo transfer and does not explain a positive hCG.
AS-1883.D: السبب إنه غلط: Intestinal obstruction: colicky pain with vomiting, distension and absolute constipation, usually after prior surgery or hernia; nothing in this stem suggests it.

AS-1884.B: السبب إنه غلط: Breech is a risk factor for cord prolapse but does not itself cause acute bradycardia; presentation is checked by abdominal exam or ultrasound.
AS-1884.C: السبب إنه غلط: Abruption (also triggered by sudden decompression of polyhydramnios) presents with pain, a tense tender uterus and bleeding; it is a clinical diagnosis and vaginal examination does not exclude it.
AS-1884.D: السبب إنه غلط: Arm prolapse occurs with transverse lie and causes obstructed labor rather than abrupt bradycardia; the emergency that compresses fetal blood flow is the cord.

AS-1885.B: السبب إنه غلط: Post-term pregnancy is linked to declining placental function and oligohydramnios, not polyhydramnios.
AS-1885.C: السبب إنه غلط: Posterior urethral valves obstruct fetal urine outflow, reducing amniotic fluid (oligohydramnios).
AS-1885.D: السبب إنه غلط: Maternal NSAIDs (e.g. indomethacin) reduce fetal renal output and cause oligohydramnios; indomethacin is even used therapeutically to reduce fluid.

AS-1886.A: السبب إنه غلط: Esophagitis gives retrosternal burning related to reflux; it is not part of preeclampsia pathophysiology.
AS-1886.B: السبب إنه غلط: Pancreatitis gives epigastric pain radiating to the back with raised lipase; it would be the answer with gallstones or alcohol, not as the mechanism of preeclamptic pain.
AS-1886.C: السبب إنه غلط: Gastric ulcer causes meal-related epigastric pain (NSAIDs, H. pylori) and is unrelated to preeclampsia.

AS-1887.B: السبب إنه غلط: Progesterone prevents preterm birth in women with a short cervix or previous spontaneous preterm birth; it does not prevent preeclampsia or FGR.
AS-1887.C: السبب إنه غلط: Multivitamins have no proven effect on preeclampsia or growth restriction risk.
AS-1887.D: السبب إنه غلط: Ferrous sulfate prevents or treats iron deficiency anemia; it does not change placental disease risk.

AS-1888.A: السبب إنه غلط: Discharge fits decreased fetal movement with a reassuring CTG and no labor (kick chart); here regular contractions and cervical change mean possible preterm labor.
AS-1888.B: السبب إنه غلط: Cesarean section needs fetal distress or an obstetric indication; this CTG is reassuring.
AS-1888.C: السبب إنه غلط: Augmentation is for established active-phase labor with inadequate contractions; it would be wrong to accelerate a preterm labor at 1 cm.

AS-1889.B: السبب إنه غلط: Internal iliac ligation is a surgical step after medical failure; operating on an uncorrected DIC patient will not stop the oozing.
AS-1889.C: السبب إنه غلط: Uterine packing (tamponade) treats bleeding from the placental bed; it cannot stop diffuse bleeding that also comes from venipuncture sites.
AS-1889.D: السبب إنه غلط: The B-Lynch compression suture is for atony at laparotomy; it is not the first step when bleeding is due to DIC.

AS-1890.A: السبب إنه غلط: Fetal hyperinsulinemia persists after the maternal glucose supply is cut at birth, causing neonatal <bdi>hypo</bdi>glycemia, not hyperglycemia.
AS-1890.B: السبب إنه غلط: Chronic fetal hypoxia stimulates erythropoiesis, so these babies are polycythemic (high hemoglobin), not anemic.
AS-1890.C: السبب إنه غلط: Fetal hypoxia raises erythropoietin levels, which is what drives the polycythemia.

AS-1891.A: السبب إنه غلط: Partial mole classically gives a uterus normal or small for dates (often with a growth restricted fetus); marked enlargement points to a complete mole instead.
AS-1891.C: السبب إنه غلط: Threatened abortion is bleeding with a closed os and a viable fetus whose size matches the dates; the uterus is not 7 weeks larger than expected.
AS-1891.D: السبب إنه غلط: Abdominal pregnancy is extrauterine, so it does not enlarge the uterus beyond dates; suspect it with abdominal pain, easily felt fetal parts and an empty uterus on imaging.

AS-1892.B: السبب إنه غلط: Plasma sodium does not increase; fluid retention and plasma volume expansion cause a small dilutional FALL of about 2 to 4 mEq/L.
AS-1892.C: السبب إنه غلط: BUN does not increase in normal pregnancy; the higher GFR lowers it by about half in the first trimester. A raised BUN suggests dehydration or renal impairment.
AS-1892.D: السبب إنه غلط: BUN is not unaffected; it falls in the first trimester for the same reason creatinine falls (raised GFR).

AS-1893.A: السبب إنه غلط: Propranolol is used short term for adrenergic symptom control (palpitations, tremor) while antithyroid drugs take effect.
AS-1893.B: السبب إنه غلط: Methimazole is avoided in the first trimester (PTU preferred then) but is the drug of choice in the second and third trimesters; it is not absolutely contraindicated.
AS-1893.C: السبب إنه غلط: Thyroidectomy is an accepted option, best in the second trimester, when drugs fail, are not tolerated or there is a compressive goiter.

AS-1903.A: السبب إنه غلط: Continued surveillance fits a steadily falling hCG; a rise plus a vaginal mass is neoplasia and needs action now.
AS-1903.B: السبب إنه غلط: Chemotherapy is the treatment, but the regimen depends on stage and risk score, so staging must come first.
AS-1903.C: السبب إنه غلط: Biopsy is not needed because the diagnosis rests on hCG and the clinical picture, and these highly vascular lesions can bleed catastrophically.

AS-1920.A: السبب إنه غلط: Propofol is an anesthetic induction agent; it may be used for anesthesia during manual removal but does nothing to stop the bleeding.
AS-1920.C: السبب إنه غلط: Nifedipine is a tocolytic and antihypertensive; relaxing the uterus would worsen atonic bleeding. It is right for preterm labor or severe hypertension in pregnancy.
AS-1920.D: السبب إنه غلط: Magnesium sulfate relaxes smooth muscle and can worsen atony; it is right for eclampsia prevention or fetal neuroprotection before 32 weeks.

AS-1944.A: السبب إنه غلط: GnRH acts on the pituitary to release FSH/LH, but in POI gonadotropins are already high and the defect is in the ovary; GnRH is useful in hypothalamic amenorrhea, not here.
AS-1944.C: السبب إنه غلط: Clomiphene works by raising endogenous FSH; in POI FSH is already elevated and the ovary cannot respond. It suits normogonadotropic anovulation such as PCOS.
AS-1944.D: السبب إنه غلط: Exogenous gonadotropins cannot stimulate a follicle-depleted ovary; they are used in hypogonadotropic hypogonadism or clomiphene-resistant PCOS.

AS-1945.A: السبب إنه غلط: GnRH injection acts on the pituitary to release FSH/LH; here FSH is already high, so the problem is ovarian, not hypothalamic. Pulsatile GnRH is right for hypothalamic amenorrhea (LOW FSH and LH).
AS-1945.B: السبب إنه غلط: Gonadotropin ovulation induction needs ovaries that can respond; a failed ovary with high endogenous FSH will not. Right for hypogonadotropic hypogonadism or clomiphene-resistant PCOS.
AS-1945.D: السبب إنه غلط: Clomiphene works by raising the patient's own FSH, which is already high here, so it adds nothing. Right for anovulatory PCOS (normal FSH) wanting pregnancy.

AS-1946.A: السبب إنه غلط: Amniocentesis is done from about 15 weeks (15 to 20 weeks), so it is too early at 12 weeks. It is right if the hygroma or abnormal screen is found in the second trimester.
AS-1946.C: السبب إنه غلط: Option not recalled. Likely distractors: termination (premature before a karyotype confirms the diagnosis) or fetal blood sampling (only later in pregnancy and higher risk).

AS-1947.A: السبب إنه غلط: Amniocentesis is done from 15 to 20 weeks, so it is too early at 12 weeks. It would be right if the hygroma were found at 16 weeks.
AS-1947.C: السبب إنه غلط: Termination before any confirmed diagnosis is premature; some fetuses with a hygroma have a normal karyotype. It is only discussed after the karyotype and counselling.
AS-1947.D: السبب إنه غلط: Cordocentesis (PUBS) is a later, higher risk procedure, used from about 18 to 20 weeks, for example for fetal anemia or a rapid karyotype late in pregnancy.

AS-0100.A: الكانديدا تعطي إفرازات بيضاء سميكة متجبنة بدون رائحة، مع حكة وفحص KOH يظهر خيوط فطرية، وليس clue cells.
AS-0100.B: التريكوموناس ممكن تكون كريهة الرائحة وإيجابية بفحص الويف، لكنها تعطي إفرازات رغوية صفراء-خضراء وعنق فراولة، لا clue cells.

AS-0111.A: الطمأنة تتجاهل خطورة حقيقية ومعروفة على المولود، وهذا خطأ أمام عدوى منقولة جنسيًا نشطة قرب الولادة.
AS-0111.C: انتظار فحص المولود بعد الولادة يفوّت فرصة الوقاية الحقيقية، اللي تكون بعلاج الأم قبل الولادة.
AS-0111.D: التحويل لأخصائي العدوى تأخير غير ضروري؛ العلاج القياسي بسيط ومباشر هنا.

AS-0125.B: الانتظار لولادة طبيعية تلقائية يعرّض جنين منهك لخطر وفاة مفاجئ قبل الولادة.
AS-0125.C: التحريض يصلح لتأخر نمو مع دوبلر طبيعي بعمر ناضج؛ هنا الدوبلر أسوأ درجة ممكنة (غياب تام للتدفق).
AS-0125.D: الطمأنة خطأ واضح أمام صورة قصور مشيمي شديد موثقة بالسونار.

AS-0128.A: الكلونيدين مو من الأدوية الموصى بها لعلاج الضغط الشديد الحاد بالحمل.
AS-0128.B: ميثيل دوبا دواء فموي بطيء المفعول لضغط خفيف أو مزمن، مو للحالات الحادة الشديدة.
AS-0128.D: نيتروبروسيد الصوديوم نادرًا ما يُستخدم بالحمل لخطورته على الجنين (تسمم سيانيد)؛ يُحجز لحالات نادرة جدًا.

AS-0129.A: الستيرويد لنضج رئة الجنين قبل ولادة مبكرة، بس ما له دور بإيقاف التشنج نفسه؛ كبريتات المغنيسيوم أولاً.
AS-0129.B: مدرات البول ما لها دور بتسمم الحمل أو الإرجاج؛ هذي المريضات أصلاً تعاني نقص حجم داخل الأوعية، والإدرار يسوء تروية المشيمة.
AS-0129.C: الهيدرالازين لخفض الضغط مهم، بس بعد السيطرة على التشنج بكبريتات المغنيسيوم أولاً.

AS-0130.A: حقنة الستيرويد مفيدة لو كان الحمل قبل ٣٤ أسبوع بوقت كافي؛ هنا بالأسبوع ٣٥ وجنين منهك، ما نأخر الولادة لأجلها.
AS-0130.C: التحريض يعرّض جنين بهذه الدرجة من نقص الأكسجين لضغط انقباضات المخاض اللي ما يتحملها.
AS-0130.D: الانتظار التوقعي خطر جدًا أمام غياب تام لتدفق نهاية الانبساط؛ هذا مؤشر ولادة فورية.

AS-0826.A: سرطان بطانة الرحم مرتبط بإستروجين زائد بدون معارضة؛ قصور المبايض المبكر حالة إستروجين منخفض.
AS-0826.B: الحمل المتعدد خطر من تحريض التبويض أو أطفال الأنابيب؛ هنا المبيض فاشل والخصوبة منخفضة جدًا.
AS-0826.C: خطر سرطان المبيض يرتبط بعوامل ثانية (وراثية، عدد مرات التبويض)؛ مو المضاعفة المباشرة لقصور المبايض هنا.

AS-0908.A: التريكوموناس تعطي إفرازات رغوية صفراء-خضراء مع عنق فراولة، مو إفرازات لبنية رقيقة.
AS-0908.B: حمل المكورة العقدية ب غير عرضي عادة، يُكتشف بفحص روتيني، وما يسبب رائحة سمكية.
